text:
arwa: :rotating_light: Customer on Dedicated (acct-337) hitting tool/function-call failures when we stream large args. Their tool args are being truncated mid-JSON during SSE stream. Root customer payload ended with an open brace. They see a client parse error when our runtime tries to deserialize.

maya: which request_id/region? any proxy in path?

arwa: request_id=rcq_0a1b2c3d, region=us-west-2, model=rw-infer-13b, customer uses our private VPC + an edge proxy (nginx) in front of the router.

arwa: Example of the snippet the customer pasted:
```json
{"call_id":"abc123","tool":"charge","args":"{\"order_id\":4521,\"amount\":49.99,\"meta\":{"
```
They get a JSONDecodeError because args ends with an unclosed brace.

sanjay: hypothesis: SSE chunking by the proxy is splitting the 'data:' payload mid-string. If our SSE consumer treats each 'data:' as a complete message and attempts to parse immediately, you get a partial JSON error.

sanjay: can you paste the raw SSE frames from router logs? Also check nginx config: proxy_buffering, proxy_max_temp_file_size, chunked_transfer_encoding.

arwa: pasted router logs (sanitized):
```
data: {"id":"abc123","tool":"charge","args":"{\"order_id\":4521,\"amount\":49.99,\n

data: \"\"meta\":{\"campaign\":\"spring\"}}\"}
```
Note second 'data' line starts with just the continuation of the args string.

eli: I can reproduce locally. Quick repro: python http client that writes two writes to the stream with a sleep in between. My curl variant:
```
# simulates proxy splitting chunks
python - <<PY
import time,sys,socket
s=socket.socket(); s.connect(('localhost',8080))
msg1=b"POST /stream HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n6\r\ndata: {\"call_id\":\"abc123\",\"tool\":\"charge\",\"args\":\"{\\\"order_id\\\":4521,\\\"amount\\\":49.99,\\\"meta\\\":{\""
"
s.send(msg1); time.sleep(0.5)
msg2=b"4\r\n\"campaign\":\"spring\"}}\"}\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
s.send(msg2)
PY
```
This reproduces the runtime JSON error if the parser treats each 'data:' line as discrete JSON.

eli: current runtime parser assumes each SSE 'data:' block is self-contained JSON. We need to make it accumulate across consecutive data lines until a parseable JSON object is found (or double newline). I can put up a small hotfix: attempt json.loads, on failure, append next data chunk and retry up to X bytes.

maya: can we do a config workaround for the customer? Suggest setting nginx proxy_buffering off and enabling proxy_http_version 1.1 + chunked_transfer_encoding off? Not ideal. Better to fix parser.

sanjay: assigned to eng-runtime (eli) for immediate patch. eli please post PR and test against python repro. If urgent, we can roll a patch to Dedicated pool with a canary.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-411, severity=low-high based on customer impact. Linking request_id rcq_0a1b2c3d.

arwa: customer asked for ETA. Can we target a patch by EOD PST? eli?

eli: I'll push a small tolerant parser change, run unit tests + repro, aim to have canary in staging within 4h. If QA passes, we can roll to a single Dedicated host for the customer.

maya: thanks. Also add telemetry to count partial-data parse retries so we can detect broader impact.

arwa: forwarding ETA and workaround (temporary nginx tweak) to customer. Will update here when they confirm.

eli: PR link: <redacted> will post CI results.

arwa: :thumbsup:
